OFFSITE 2 Day ESTATE SALE being held at the 
***Dover Township Community Center, 3700 Davidsburg Rd, Dover, PA 17315***

8-4pm Saturday 11/14/26
8-4pm Sunday 12/15/26 (50% off day!)

Sand Stone Acres Vintage Finds LLC is back with our next estate sale — we are back at the Dover Township Community center! Same great finds, same curated setup — a bright, easy to shop space. Photos will be updated throughout this week and later Friday evening after set up is complete! 

We will be packed again this time with a great variety of records, cds, vintage and new holiday (blow molds, lots and lots of hallmark ornaments and a few ceramic trees), crafting items (including material, yarn, wood boards), home décor and smaller furniture pieces (including some live plants), Longaberger baskets, vintage collectibles, antique sheet music, glassware, toys and games, household goods, costume jewelry, tools, kitchenware, and countless unique finds. Whether you’re a collector, crafter, reseller, or treasure hunter, this sale is loaded with variety and value. The photos are just a snapshot of what was in this home!

Key Reminders for the Sale:
Doors open promptly at 8:00am. Entry/Exit will be through the marked entrance at the center.

Payments: Cash preferred. Venmo and major credit cards accepted (3% processing fee automatically added to all credit card purchases).

All Sales Final: No returns, exchanges, or refunds. All items sold as is, with no warranties.

Pricing: Prices are firm unless otherwise noted. Final day discounts may be offered at our discretion.

Liability: Sand Stone Acres Vintage Finds is not responsible for accidents or injuries. Entry is at your own risk.

Item Removal: All purchases must be removed the day it is purchased. Please bring your own bags and boxes and help if purchasing larger furniture or heavy items.

Entry & Access: Entry may be limited based on space and crowd size. We reserve the right to refuse entry.

Parking: Plenty of it at the community building!

Security: Surveillance may be in use. Large bags, backpacks, and purses may be inspected.

Conduct: Be a nice human! Respectful behavior is required. Disruptive individuals may be asked to leave.

Signage & Directions: Please follow all posted signs and staff instructions.

Announcements: Day of sale announcements override all prior information.

Attendance: By entering the sale, you agree to these terms. Thank you for your cooperation — happy treasure hunting!
